div.class: alert alert-info d-flex align-items-start gap-2 mb-3
div.div: Adds a new customer. Enter what they already owe the shop as the opening balance, or leave it at zero. Adds a new vendor. Enter what the shop already owes them as the opening balance, or leave it at zero. A contact shows in the ledger once it has an entry.

li.span: vendor ya us ki dukaan ka naam.

ul.li: Opening Balance: is customer ne pehle se dukaan ko kitne paisay dene hain (purana khata). dukaan ne is vendor ko pehle se kitne paisay dene hain (purana khata). Kuch nahi dena to 0 rehne dein.
Balance As Of: yeh balance kis din tak ka hai.

div.div: Zaroori: sirf raqam likhein, minus (-) na lagayein.

div.class: alert alert-info d-flex align-items-start gap-2 mb-3
div.div: Corrects this one entry in place. The ledger and the balance change as soon as you save. To take the entry out altogether, close this and use Cancel Entry.

ul.li: Amount: is entry ki sahi raqam.
Balance goes UP: udhaar barhega. Customer ne dukaan ko zyada dena hai. Dukaan ne vendor ko zyada dena hai. Purana khata ya udhaar likhna ho to yeh chunein.
Balance goes DOWN: udhaar kam hoga. Customer ne dukaan ko kam dena hai. Dukaan ne vendor ko kam dena hai. Discount, maal wapsi ya zyada likha gaya ho to yeh chunein.
Date: jis din ka yeh hisaab hai.
Note: likhein ke kya theek kiya.

div.div: Zaroori: UP aur DOWN dhyan se chunein. Ghalat chuna to balance ulta ho jayega.
Zaroori: payment hamesha udhaar kam karti hai. Yahan sirf raqam, date ya note theek karein.

div.class: alert alert-warning d-flex align-items-start gap-2 mb-3
div.div: Records money the shop has paid to this vendor. The amount goes out of the till or the bank and comes off what the shop owes them, oldest bills first. To correct a vendor balance with no money changing hands, use Vendor Khata Adjustment.

form.div:
Har khanay ka matlab (asaan Urdu):
Shop Currently Owes: abhi dukaan ne is vendor ko itne paisay dene hain. Agar minus (-) ho to hum zyada de chuke hain.
Amount Paid: abhi vendor ko kitne paisay diye. Yeh raqam udhaar mein se kam ho jayegi.
Paid From: paisay kahan se diye: galla (cash) ya bank / online.
Date: jis din paisay diye.
Note: cheque number ya koi yaad-dasht. Zaroori nahi.
Misaal: dena 40,000 tha, 10,000 diye, to baqi 30,000 reh gaye.
Zaroori: yeh sirf tab use karein jab vendor ko paisay DIYE hon. Discount mila ho ya ghalti theek karni ho to "Vendor Khata Adjustment" use karein.
That is more than the shop owes this vendor. The extra is kept as an advance against their next bill.
